<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"fdcbbec0a81e7ca2dd5f67001670b92d624a0b1d2ffe6f3edc2467c6ff21ca95"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — ENVIRONMENT:⁠ Locked adguard_cli (AdGuard CLI 1.4.13; filterBaseline executable, reporter's 13 lists mapped, Online Malicious URL Blocklist skipped as third_party_catalog). Conflicts recorded:⁠ the instruction's `application: adguard-extension` line vs the issue's product field/label "AdGuard for Android" (VPN mode, HTTPS filtering); the host offering both browser_extension (available) and adguard_cli (preparable) — the mobile-app website-filtering report was routed to adguard_cli by the routing guidance, not by capability count; extension="none" sessions accept no `settings`, so the reporter import URL could not be applied and every session ran through the CLI proxy with the reporter's lists. Further conflict:⁠ the reporter's screenshot shows the article rendered, while the locked baseline shows an anti-adblock notice instead. REPORTED TARGET (issue screenshot 1, vision):⁠ one in-article card outlined in red — blue header "VICTORY STAMP COLLECTION", yellow body "応募受付は終了しました。", "©阪神タイガース", black "スタンプ台紙を見る" button — in the article flow below the "続きを見る" button and above the reaction widget. Label T:⁠ Annoyance; no blank ad placeholder in the reporter capture. CANDIDATE EVIDENCE:⁠ in four filtered sessions (3x mobile 375x812, 1x desktop 1920x1080) the only stamp-related requests on this exact URL, unblocked with HTTP 200, are the device variants of one ad-directory widget:⁠ https:⁠//i.daily.jp/Koukoku/Images/win_stamp_sp.js?a=v0520261023 (mobile) and https:⁠//i.daily.jp/Koukoku/Images/win_stamp_pc.js?a=0520261023 (desktop). "/Koukoku/" is the site's advertising-creative directory (it also served /Koukoku/Images/verticalPhoto.033102.js, google_logo100x100.png, tokoname_basic_202603.png) and this repository already blocks it with ||daily.jp/Koukoku/$image in JapaneseFilter/sections/specific.txt, plus the exception @⁠@⁠||i.daily.jp/Koukoku/Images/ds_noimage.jpg$domain=daily.co.jp. (shortened; the full text is in the run artifacts)

## Missing information

- No documented way to satisfy the required complete full-page vision when full-page screenshots time out: The terminal gate requires complete full-page vision from the activated CLI-proxy session ("capture_complete_page":⁠ every original-resolution tile plus an overview), but on the reported URL https:⁠//daily.co.jp/tigers/2026/11/10/0021017478.shtml every full-page and tiled screenshot fails with "page.screenshot:⁠ Timeout 45000ms exceeded ... waiting for fonts to load ... fonts loaded", in six attempts across three CLI sessions (375x812 mobile and 1920x1080 desktop), and inspect_full_page_capture answers full_page_capture_incomplete (retryable:⁠false) while telling me to continue with viewport/DOM/network evidence. Only the plain viewport screenshot succeeds, and it covers the whole document because documentHeight equals viewportHeight (812 px). The page renders with no <⁠body⁠> element at all (documentElement children are head plus one cross-origin iframe from report.error-report.com), which is the likely reason full-page capture never completes, but no tool result proves that cause. There is no documented procedure to complete or waive the full-page vision requirement in this state, so an honest analysis-only outcome cannot be delivered:⁠ the required action (capture_complete_page) is mechanically impossible and every resubmission is rejected with cli_route_full_vision_required.

The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Not reproduced — No ad is served on the reported page under the reporter's own filter set:⁠ the only third-party ad loader (pagead2.googlesyndication.com/tag/js/gpt.js) is already blocked by AdGuard Base '/gpt.js$script', and every visible banner is Migros's own promotion. The request the reporter arrowed, https:⁠//www⁠.migros.com.tr/analytics/, is a first-party proxy of Google's tag/measurement stack (GTM container, GA4 collect, Google Ads conversion AW-715674769), not ad creative — recommend closing.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

No repository-policy rule refuses this report, so rule generation was allowed and evaluated; the close is a reproduction result, not a policy refusal. Policy note also checked:⁠ the page's own promotional banners are the site's own (first-party) advertising, which the run instruction's policy does not block. The only remaining candidate would have been a first-party analytics/measurement proxy rule, which is not an ad-filter fix and carries unverified functional risk, so it was not proposed.

## Artifacts

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The reported annoyance is the first-party Oracle HCM cookie-consent notice fixed in the lower-right corner of hcri.fa.em2.oraclecloud.com, still shown with the reporter's Cookie Notices filter enabled. Extending the existing multi-domain `.cookie-consent-modal` hiding rule to this host removes it, verified in the browser-extension environment with page integrity intact. ## Rule `hcri.fa.em2.oraclecloud.com##.cookie-consent-modal` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie-notice annoyance; it is not the site's own advertising, not a paywall, and not a German or other anti-adblock wall, so no rule of the run instruction closes it. Filter policy places cookie notices in the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, and hiding the notice leaves the page working (no scroll lock, no content gated behind a consent decision). ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/8a04e5968f77f98835312f7ad669c2a88deb9eba/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) By adding the domain to the existing rule on [line 11530](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/8a04e5968f77f98835312f7ad669c2a88deb9eba/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L11530). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — gotradio.com leaves a gold circular floating social share widget (.proradio-shareball, fixed at the right edge above the audio player) visible because the Social Media filter only hides its individual network links; no list covers the widget. Hiding the container was verified in the reporter-profile baseline (symptom resolved, page integrity intact) and the controlled profile shows the same widget, so it is not configuration-specific. ## Rule `gotradio.com##.proradio-shareball` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The reported defect is a third-party social share/reaction widget, which the AdGuard Social Media filter exists to block:⁠ 'this filter will block social media widgets on third-party websites, such as "Like" and "Share" buttons, group widgets, recommendations, and similar widgets'. None of the instruction's close conditions applies:⁠ it is not the site's own advertising, not a paywall, and not a German or other anti-adblock wall, so the report is open to rule generation. The widget is not one of the policy exceptions (comments, embedded posts, polls, social login widgets, or plain links to the site's own social pages):⁠ it is a floating share/like/email ball. The run instruction reserves extension reports for the browser-extension blocker route, and the locked baseline was the reporter's own list selection, so the fix ships in a shared filter list used by every product. ## Place in the list [SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/a9a34cc2a94a146aefa3daee70a903b50b06850d/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt) Next to the site's existing rules, before [line 13](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/a9a34cc2a94a146aefa3daee70a903b50b06850d/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt#L13). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/42745042008 Automated analysis against filters at `a9a34cc`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.
